hell-on-weils.title: Leptospirosis: reservoir, environment, exposure
hell-on-weils.desc: Reservoir kidney leads to Shed in urine, which leads to Fresh water and wet soil. That water and soil lead back to Reservoir kidney, and also to Broken skin or a mucous membrane. Infected mammals, rats in particular, can carry Leptospira in the kidney and shed it in urine. A person is exposed the same way and is not what keeps the cycle going. Some infections cause no illness. Weil's disease is a severe form.
hell-on-weils.sources: Sources: Levett, Clinical Microbiology Reviews (2001); Haake and Levett, Current Topics in Microbiology and Immunology (2015).

a-sky-full-of-sars--spike.title: SARS coronavirus: spike, receptor and host range
a-sky-full-of-sars--spike.desc: The SARS coronavirus has a crown of spike proteins. A spike binds ACE2, a receptor on a human cell, like a key in a lock. The 2002 to 2003 outbreak in people was followed by the discovery of related coronaviruses in bats, and of a closely related virus in palm civets sold in markets in southern China.
a-sky-full-of-sars--spike.sources: Sources: Li and colleagues, Nature (2003); Li and colleagues, Science (2005); Guan and colleagues, Science (2003).

one-flew-over-the-kuru-nest.title: Prion templating
one-flew-over-the-kuru-nest.desc: Cells make PrPC leads to PrPSc templates more PrPSc, which leads to The misfolded form can spread. Cells make the prion protein as PrPC. PrPSc can bind PrPC and favor its refolding into more PrPSc. Kuru is a human disease of this kind among the Fore and their neighbors, and it was transmitted experimentally.
one-flew-over-the-kuru-nest.sources: Sources: Prusiner, Science (1982); Pan and colleagues, PNAS (1993); Gajdusek, Gibbs and Alpers, Nature (1966); Alpers, Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B (2008).

on-the-right-taq.title: One cycle of PCR
on-the-right-taq.desc: Denature leads to Anneal, which leads to Extend, which leads to Repeat. Denature is heat separating the two DNA strands. Anneal is primers binding, at a temperature that depends on the primers. Extend is Taq polymerase, from Thermus aquaticus, copying each strand and staying active through the heat. Repeat is those copies becoming templates.
on-the-right-taq.sources: Sources: Saiki and colleagues, Science (1988); Chien, Edgar and Trela, Journal of Bacteriology (1976); Mullis and Faloona, Methods in Enzymology (1987).

its-on-the-syphilis--stages.title: The four stages of untreated syphilis
its-on-the-syphilis--stages.desc: Untreated syphilis moves through four stages. In the primary stage a sore appears where it entered and lasts 3 to 6 weeks. The secondary stage brings a rash, which can be on the palms and soles, starting as the sore heals or several weeks later. The latent stage has no visible signs or symptoms. A tertiary stage, 10 to 30 years after infection began, can damage the heart and blood vessels and the brain and nervous system.
its-on-the-syphilis--stages.sources: Sources: CDC, About Syphilis; Workowski and colleagues, MMWR Recommendations and Reports 70(4) (2021); Stamm, Microbial Cell (2016).
